verifications.claim: A Falcon 9 successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, on April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from its Falcon 9 rocket on Monday evening... on Monday, April 6, 2026 from Vandenberg Space Force Base'; R5: 'A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched from Vandenberg Space Force Base... carrying 25 Starlink satellites'; R6: 'A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket... from Vandenberg Space Force Base... carrying Starlink satellites'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm successful launch of 25 Starlink satellites on the exact date and location.

verifications.claim: The Falcon 9 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA on April 6, 2026 occurred at 7:50 p.m. PDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The liftoff is scheduled for Monday at 7:49 p.m. PT'; R6: 'lifted off around 7:50 p.m.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm liftoff time as approximately 7:49-7:50 p.m. PT/PDT on the specified date and location.

verifications.claim: The first stage of the Falcon 9 landed on a droneship during the launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA on April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the first stage booster will return and touch down on the Of Course I Still Love You droneship'; R2: 'the first stage will land on the "Of Course I Still Love You" drone ship'; R5: 'the first stage returned to Earth, making a safe landing on a drone ship'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm droneship landing plan and success for the specific launch.

verifications.claim: A Falcon 9 is set to launch a Dragon spacecraft from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, FL, on April 9, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R8: 'SpaceX is preparing to launch a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on Thursday, April 9th... carrying an uncrewed Dragon spacecraft'
verifications.reasoning: Source directly states the planned launch details matching claim exactly.

verifications.claim: The Dragon spacecraft will deliver 6,000+ pounds of supplies to the ISS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R8: 'carrying an uncrewed Dragon spacecraft loaded with over 6,000 pounds of supplies... for the ISS crew'
verifications.reasoning: Source confirms exact payload details for the Dragon mission.

verifications.claim: A Falcon 9 completed a record 34th flight of a first-stage booster for a Starlink mission on March 30, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Falcon 9 booster... made a record-breaking 34th flight Monday on a mission to deploy a batch of... Starlink satellites... Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station... March 30, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Source directly confirms record 34th booster flight on Starlink mission on the exact date.

verifications.claim: Falcon 9 launch sites are primarily Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida and Vandenberg Space Force Base in California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9: 'Florida Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Space Launch Complex 40... California Vandenberg Space Force Base, Space Launch Complex 4 East'
verifications.reasoning: Source lists these as primary Falcon 9 launch sites, matching the claim.
